convention: HumanML3D 22-joint (SMPL order). y-up, metres, 20 fps. Subject left = +x, initial facing +z. Left_* joints carry the subject's left side.
imu_generation: Joints -> BVH via inverse kinematics (Motion/InverseKinematics animation_from_positions, data_generation.motion2bvh_ik), BVH offsets scaled by 1.7/1.55 (rescale_bvh), then IMUSim IdealIMU with trajectory = splinedModel.getJoint(<joint>) (sensor.py extract_vir_imu, version=ideal). So each virtual sensor sits AT the joint position and rotates with that joint's BVH frame, i.e. the segment from the joint to its child. Leaf joints (Head, *_wrist) have no IK rotation of their own and inherit the parent frame (confirmed: Left_wrist gyro == Left_elbow gyro exactly). acc = specific force in m/s^2 incl. gravity; gyro rad/s; sensor-local axes.

realworld.name: chest
realworld.note: Spine3 has 3 children; IK frame follows the upper-chest block

realworld.name: upperarm
realworld.note: placed at the elbow; orientation is the FOREARM segment (elbow->wrist), not the upper arm

realworld.name: forearm
realworld.note: leaf joint; orientation = forearm (identical gyro to upperarm site)

realworld.name: thigh
realworld.note: placed at the knee; orientation is the SHANK segment (knee->ankle), not the thigh

realworld.name: shin
realworld.note: placed at the ankle; orientation is the FOOT segment (ankle->foot)

usc-had.name: hip
usc-had.note: USC-HAD real sensor is at the front right hip; orientation = right THIGH (hip->knee)

usc-had.name: knee
usc-had.note: second virtual site present in the generated data; orientation = right shank
